hypothesis_construction.formula_double: double_uwb_accel = single_uwb_structural * (3 * occurrences); double_uwb_gyro = single_uwb_structural * (3 * occurrences)
hypothesis_construction.note: occurrences = committed epochs whose factor groups are explicitly inside the frozen window (rejected epochs drop out); structural UWB modes = 2 per (anchor,onset) [+1 ramp] with onsets spanning [detector_first_epoch, proposed_epoch]
